rule: Bare names resolve through local bindings, the module, import lists (with `T (..)` fields and hiding), unqualified imports of scanned modules (following `module M` re-exports and export lists), the Prelude (`Prelude.show`, medium) and the one unlisted external import; qualified imports `Map.size` medium.
notes: Qualified imports of external modules are named as written and medium (Haskell note: "qualified imports `Map.size` medium"). Without an alias the qualifier as written is the full module name, `Data.Set.size`.
